Daily coverage & data import

PM₂.₅ is loaded from the bundled city snapshot; ERA5 can be queried on demand. A daily refresh workflow is included in the source, but is not enabled for this preview. ERA5 typically lags by about 5 days, so recent windows may not reach 27 valid days. Missing values are not replaced with forecasts or other pollution models.

Import daily PM₂.₅ for the selected city (date,pm25,n_valid_hours). Each day needs at least 20 valid hours. Files are read locally.

02 / MODEL & EVIDENCE

A clear provenance for every result.

01

Purpose & data provenance

This is a teaching companion to the manuscript. Source documentation records outcome-directed adjustments to 144 POD2–7 Hb values across 86 records. Performance on this scenario is not real-world clinical validation.

The task begins after a measured POD1 Hb in total knee arthroplasty. Performance in new regions, seasons and real clinical populations remains unvalidated.

02

Weights & manuscript version

Each trajectory averages 15 existing checkpoints (5 folds × 3 seeds). The separate ridge-logistic risk models were refitted on all 131 eligible teaching records using the manuscript’s method.

Neither the web ensemble nor the deployment risk refit inherits the manuscript’s out-of-fold performance. No trajectory model was retrained for this site.

03

A documented version discrepancy

The manuscript reports an environmental MAE of 5.87 g/L; the available local result table reports 10.03 g/L. Clinical-calendar values are 10.95 and 11.12 g/L, respectively.

The site uses the verified local checkpoints. It does not claim to reproduce the manuscript’s 5.87 g/L or to provide validated individual clinical risks.

Architecture, interpretation & privacy

From input to output

Measured POD1 Hb + a population curve + an individualized residual. Features undergo median imputation, IQR scaling and an asinh transform, with missingness indicators. Feature tokens, time-query attention and two experts generate residuals. Time bases are zero at POD1. Calendar terms use surgery date; exposure windows use admission date.

A separate ridge-logistic model with C=1 estimates the recorded low-Hb event. Risk is not inferred from the trajectory minimum. Average error is not presented as an individual prediction interval.

Where information goes

Clinical fields are processed in your browser and are not written to a server or persistent browser storage. Environmental requests send city-center coordinates and date windows to Open-Meteo. No name, hospital ID or street address is needed. Hosting and data providers may retain access logs.

Downloads are generated in your browser and include your entered values; handle them according to your data policies. Static website resources contain environmental observations and model parameters, not source patient tables.
